question: Related Questions Q. My wife after few years of marriage filed criminal cases against me and my family members and I also filed cases. Your early reply in this regard shall be help me in the right direction. 1619 views Q. On behalf of distributing food for swaab for late person 3593 views Q. Asalamu alaykum. I am an American Convert. Have been muslim for 1 year and 5 months now. I am currently talking to a man from Egypt regarding engagement/marriage. He's going about it the proper way by talking to my guardian (since my father is not muslim) and his parents have agreed. But now I have a big problem. I understand in Islam that women and men shouldn't talk more than business. He asked me to delete the friends from my internet accounts who I didn't even talk to. Out of respect for him and because I knew that I would need to for marriage anyway I did this. But now he still has sisters who he works with or who are students that he advises on his account. He got angry with me when I asked him if he could do the same and delete them. He said that in Egypt men are allowed to but women can't (which is impossible anyway). Is this simply a cultural issue or is there some proof in Quran and Sunnah. I know it's hard because it's over the internet, but what can I do? Is it right for him to keep his female aqaintances when I can't? I've told him my feelings and I don't like it. Another problem I have is that I can't usually read what these women comment on his profile either as it's in Arabic and I speak very little. Please help. 2239 views Q. I am living in Lucknow. Is machine slaughter halal or haram? 17056 views Q. I write to request a fatwa on smoking of Tobacco. Through my up bringing here in the UK I have been fortunate enough to be within reach of some very well respected scholars of Islam. I know from them smoking tobacco has been always regarded as makrooh. As I am unable to direct this question to them I felt I should contact you. It has always frustated me why it is regarded as makrooh more so recently when smoking is now related to ill health. In the UK cigarette packets carry warnings which basically warn people that smoking can lead to health problems ie cancer, they often carry the slogan "Smoking Kills". With all the latest data available on smoking tobacco and the related health issues, should smoking tobacco now be regarded as haraam? If cigarette smoking is makrooh or haraam, what about selling or handling this product? I also note from fatwa 2409 that the people of hell will discharge smoke from their mouth, so to resemble them are we not comitting an act that the people of hell will comitt? My full name is Abdulhannan, many people call me Hannan, some people I have come across from the middle east advise me that I should change my name from Hannan as it is a girl's name and the meaning is motherley love or I get told Abdulhannan is not sifat of Allah swt so I must change my name even on this circumstance. Please can you advise me on this and the correct format of my name? If my name is incorrect what should I change it to? Jazakallah Khair for your time and effort. May Allah swt reward you and your family for your efforts to bring a better understanding of Islam to people like me, AMEEN. 14157 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 27562 Country: India Title: I heard about women going to work is not allowed,but if a women,who done MBBS,gynecologist and wants to serve for people.Her job is to attend pregnant cases and also to treat normal cases,and at time she will also faces male patient.My question is the money earning from this work is Haram or Halal. Question: Assalamu Alaikum, I heard about women going to work is not allowed,but if a women,who done MBBS,gynecologist and wants to serve for people.Her job is to attend pregnant cases and also to treat normal cases,and at time she will also faces male patient.My question is the money earning from this work is Haram or Halal. Answer ID: 27562 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1607/1607/M=1431) If a woman does lawful job in exigent cases observing the shariah limits, her job and income will not be termed as haram but the income shall be halal. However, it is not lawful for a woman to step out of home unnecessarily and face non-mahram men without observing purdah etc. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
